_comment: Voices the office offers, all Silero on the CPU (no GPU). id = silero:<name>; a named preset sets the Silero speaker in params. role: system (the HQ's own voice), lead (AM7), crew (operational hackers), any. 'fx' is the post-processing heard on the voice: humanoid-heavy («Система штаба»: -4 semitones with formants kept, 6 % slower, grit, octave sub, ring-mod and metal comb, tight room), humanoid-heavy-lead (AM7: the same, -6 semitones, 9 % slower, more grit; a different speaker, so he never sounds like the system) or humanoid-hard (the crew: -3 semitones, lighter). 'gender' picks the grammatical form of the crew's lines. The older ids voicestudio:am7 and voicestudio:crew-m1..m6 (saved settings, the voice bank) resolve to these presets.

voices.label: AM7
voices.description: Главный хакер: самый низкий бас штаба, медленно и холодно, металл андроида
